# BAD-031 — Drop the unused CURRENT_APP_VERSION import from admin/src/app/accounts/page.tsx

## Brief
It is the only lint warning admin CI raises in a file anyone is likely to touch, and a standing warning trains people to skim past the lint output — which is where a real one would appear. One line, no behaviour.

Evidence: npm run lint in admin/ on a clean tree: 'admin/src/app/accounts/page.tsx  9:10  warning  CURRENT_APP_VERSION is defined but never used  @typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars'. Line 9 imports { CURRENT_APP_VERSION, versionBehind } from '@/lib/shared'; only versionBehind is used (the Version column's 'behind' badge). Pre-existing and untouched by BAD-027 — confirmed absent from this branch's diff — and left alone because the brief says nothing else on the page changes. The other warning, Rail.tsx:102 window.location.href, is a real judgement call and not part of this.

## Size, persona and model decision
One scout on haiku, no children: a one-line import removal with no behaviour change. Law 1's tiny case. Proof is admin/'s typecheck, lint (the warning gone) and build; landing is a PR.
